title: Predicting growth, water-use efficiency and drought response through machine learning, GWAS and differential expression in Ponderosa pine
summary: Machine-learning and genome-wide association analyses identified trait-linked genomic signals and predicted ponderosa-pine growth, water-use efficiency and drought response; reported performance varies by trait. Publisher citation metadata lists 2026/12; the checked first result-bearing source version is dated 2026-05-29.
